title: Guidelines and Autonomy Given on Disbursement Amounts for MediFund Applications
what_it_is: Guidelines and Autonomy Given on Disbursement Amounts for MediFund Applications

sections.label: MediFund eligibility and committee discretion
sections.summary: MediFund applicants must be Singapore Citizens, subsidised patients at approved institutions, with committees holding full discretion over assessment and approval.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To apply for MediFund, applicants must be Singapore Citizens who are subsidised patients and are receiving treatment from a MediFund-approved institution.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As long as patients meet these eligibility criteria, the MediFund Committees (MFCs) have flexibility and discretion over the assessment, approval and assistance quantum of MediFund applications.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH provides operational guidelines to MediFund-approved institutions to facilitate their management of MediFund and to provide some consistency for decision making, although MFCs retain full discretion over assessment of applications.

sections.label: Committees may deviate from guidelines
sections.summary: The committees are given full discretion to deviate from the suggested guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The full discretion is given to these committees to actually deviate from these suggested guidelines.

sections.label: MediFund approval rates in 2020
sections.summary: In fiscal year 2020, 98.3% of MediFund and MediFund Silver applications were approved and 87.6% of approved applications received full assistance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In fiscal year 2020, 98.3% of the total number of MediFund and MediFund Silver applications that were received were approved and 87.6% of the approved applications received the full assistance.

sections.label: Annual audit of MediFund accounts
sections.summary: MediFund accounts and administration for each preceding financial year are audited annually by AGO or an external auditor appointed by MOH.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In terms of auditing some of these outcomes and making sure that the spirit of MediFund is complied with, the MediFund accounts and administration for each preceding financial year are audited annually, either by Auditor-General's Office (AGO) or an external auditor appointed by MOH in consultation with AGO.
